fact: The Auditor General found the Ministry of Finance and National Planning's IFMIS and PMEC backups had no off-site copy as at 31 August 2025, and the Government Service Bus BCDRP approved in 2024 had not been tested.
title: Report of the Auditor General on the Accounts of the Republic for the Financial Year Ended 31st December 2024
publisher: Office of the Auditor General, Republic of Zambia
